bridge.narrative: The Saturday arxiv 2605.05933 (MIT CSAIL + ETH Zurich + Anthropic) provides a citable formal-verification framework for per-tenant capability attestation; Defender quarantines climb to 24% of net-new MCP servers, Sysdig logs 19-minute median credential-extraction on unprotected estates, and the 41-enterprise gated cohort delivers exactly the cross-vendor empirical baseline a NIST profile would consolidate.

bridge.narrative: Shadowserver day-nine n8n exposed instances drop to ~6,800 (44% unpatched) ahead of the CISA May 21 federal-civilian deadline; NHS England's five-CVE blocklist now functions as the de-facto allied reference, and Sysdig's 19-minute median time-to-credential-extraction puts a measurable cost on absent secure-deployment guidance — the exact predicate set a CISA guide would consolidate.
bridge.remaining_gap: CISA has not yet issued a draft secure-deployment guide naming the agentic-AI workflow-platform control set.

bridge.narrative: NHS England's blocklist names five distinct agentic-runtime CVEs (Ni8mare, LangGraph, LiteLLM, CrewAI, Haystack) tied to the CISA May 21 KEV-mirroring deadline, and Trail of Bits publishes a sixth (SGLang RadixArk CVE-2026-44567 CVSS 8.1) the same week — the empirical base for a distinguishable agentic-AI CVE class hardens, but advisory coordination still flows through CISA / GitLab / OWASP / NHS rather than a CSAI CNA.
bridge.remaining_gap: No dedicated CSAI Foundation CNA assignment authority has shipped; sub-corpus carve-out remains conceptual.
